It then derives the formula P(x_2D) = ϱ' · D specifically for this homogeneous/uniform case. The subsequent section introduces an 'Exponential medium' for cases where density is not constant. Therefore, the evidence supports the claim that the simple linear integration formula P = ϱ' · D is applicable to uniform (homogeneous) media.
